name: showup
description: Capture real work, draft personal content, publish approved posts, and learn from the results.

interface.shortDescription: Turn your work into posts that sound like you.
interface.longDescription: Runs a four-part personal content loop: capture evidence from real work, turn it into relatable drafts, move approved copy through Typefully, and review results without creating another task system.
defaultPrompt: Capture the strongest content moment from today's work.
Turn this build decision into a relatable post.
Save the approved draft to Typefully.
Review this week's content and pick the next story.
